rationale: This mutation eliminates the -$9,500 cash deficit by front-loading contiguous land expansion (20-24 plots) to Day 9-10 with a hard freeze at Day 10 and collapsing the Carrot bootstrap to a single cycle (Days 1-3) to transition core acreage to hyper-fertilized Strawberries on Day 3 morning, capturing up to 12 recurring flushes. It eradicates post-harvest regrowth freezes by mandating proactive watering can refills (< 30% capacity) before harvest passes to guarantee 100% immediate same-tick in-situ watering. Finally, it protects crop margins by elevating liquidation price floors (>= 0.88x standard, >= 0.82x hard minimum), raising batch surplus liquidation to >= 8 items (with day <= 3 bootstrap support), integrating midday shed drops for Town Shop arbitrage, and banning Carrot purchases after Day 10.
